# TikLive TTS

> TikLive TTS is a free, open-source Windows desktop app that reads TikTok Live, Twitch and YouTube Live chat out loud (text-to-speech, 13 languages) and shows OBS-ready overlays for gift alerts, likes and followers. No account or sign-up required.

Official site: https://tiklivetts.es/
Source code: https://github.com/iKhunsa/tiktok-tts
Community: https://discord.com/invite/mwY859tcQK

## Key facts

- Price: free, no paid tier, no locked features. Funded by voluntary donations.
- License: open source, full code on GitHub.
- Platforms read simultaneously: TikTok Live, Twitch, YouTube Live.
- Languages: 13 text-to-speech languages/voices.
- Requires no account, no login, runs locally on Windows.
- OBS integration via local Browser Source overlays (gift alerts, like counter, follower counter).
- Includes anti-spam filtering, viewer moderation (mute/ban), and auto-reconnect with backoff.
